subject.title: fix(agents): treat unterminated Responses SSE stream as error, not success

question: Which open implementation should become the canonical fix for Responses streams that end without a terminal event: this PR or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109133?
rationale: Both branches target the same user-visible false-success failure but use different transport-boundary mechanics; choosing one defines the compatibility and error-propagation contract for OpenAI-compatible Responses providers.

options.title: Adopt this PR as canonical
options.body: Land this terminal-state implementation after confirming that treating missing terminal events as hard errors is the intended compatibility contract.

options.title: Adopt the competing transport-boundary PR
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109133 if maintainers want failure to originate directly at the stream parser boundary.

options.title: Consolidate the strongest coverage
options.body: Choose one branch as the base and retain only the non-duplicative regression and real-stream proof coverage from the other.

recommendation.title: Consolidate the strongest coverage
recommendation.body: Choose one branch as the base and retain only the non-duplicative regression and real-stream proof coverage from the other.
